#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Round 7: remaining grammar combinations."""
import json, subprocess, sys

CTX = {
    "directory": {"sip:ember@studio.test": ["sip:e1@alias.studio.test", "tel:+12025550121"]},
    "accounts": {"s": {"primary": "sip:ember@studio.test", "allow": []}},
    "gateways": {"g": {"local_domains": ["studio.test"], "peers": {"p": ["studio.test"]}}},
}
def run(raw, ing=None, gw="g", out=True):
    batch = dict(CTX)
    batch["jobs"] = [{"gateway": gw, "ingress": ing or {"kind": "local", "subject": "s"},
                      "trusted_out": out, "raw": raw}]
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/workspace/submission/gateway.py"],
                          input=json.dumps(batch).encode(), capture_output=True)
    assert proc.returncode == 0, proc.stderr[-2000:]
    return json.loads(proc.stdout)["results"][0]

def mk(lines, body="hi"):
    return ("MESSAGE sip:inbox@relay.test SIP/2.0\r\n"
            + "".join(l + "\r\n" for l in lines)
            + "Content-Length: %d\r\n\r\n%s" % (len(body), body))

BASE = ["From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q", "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>",
        "Call-ID: c", "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE"]
fails = []
def check(name, lines, status, reason=None, body="hi"):
    got = run(mk(lines, body))
    ok = got.get("status") == status and (reason is None or got.get("reason") == reason)
    if not ok:
        fails.append(name); print("FAIL %-38s %s" % (name, json.dumps(got)))
    else:
        print("ok   %-38s %s" % (name, got.get("status") or got.get("reason")))

# compact/full duplicates of singletons
check("ctype-compact-dup", BASE + ["c: text/plain", "Content-Type: text/plain"], "reject", "syntax")
check("ctype-compact-ok", BASE + ["c: text/plain"], "accept")
check("callid-compact-dup", ["From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q", "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>",
                             "i: c", "Call-ID: c", "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE"], "reject", "syntax")
check("cl-compact-dup", BASE + ["l: 2"], "reject", "syntax")
check("from-compact-dup", ["From: <sip:ember@studio.test>", "f: <sip:ember@studio.test>",
                           "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>", "Call-ID: c", "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE"],
      "reject", "syntax")
check("to-compact-dup", BASE + ["t: <sip:inbox@relay.test>"], "reject", "syntax")
check("pai-compact-n/a", BASE + ["P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>",
                                 "P-asserted-identity: <tel:+12025550121>"], "accept")
check("pai-case-dup-counts", BASE + ["P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>",
                                     "p-asserted-identity: <sip:e1@alias.studio.test>"],
      "reject", "syntax")

# content-type odd values
check("ctype-colon", BASE + ["Content-Type: multipart/mixed;boundary=x:y"], "accept")
check("ctype-only-wsp", BASE + ["Content-Type: \t "], "reject", "syntax")
check("ctype-folded-wsp", ["From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q", "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>",
                           "Call-ID: c", "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE", "Content-Type: text/plain",
                           "\t;charset=utf-8"], "accept")

# tags
check("tag-then-wsp", ["From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q ", "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>",
                       "Call-ID: c", "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE"], "accept")
check("tag-equals-only", ["From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;=", "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>",
                          "Call-ID: c", "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE"], "reject", "syntax")
check("tag-semi-only", ["From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;", "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>",
                        "Call-ID: c", "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE"], "reject", "syntax")
check("tag-two-params", ["From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=a;x=1", "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>",
                         "Call-ID: c", "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE"], "reject", "syntax")
check("tag-named-case", ["From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tAg=q7", "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>",
                         "Call-ID: c", "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE"], "accept")

# tel rules
check("tel-15-first-nonzero", ["From: <tel:+912345678901234>;tag=q", "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>",
                               "Call-ID: c", "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE"], "accept")
check("tel-leading-zero-15", ["From: <tel:+012345678901234>;tag=q", "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>",
                              "Call-ID: c", "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE"], "reject", "syntax")
check("tel-plus-then-nonzero", ["From: <tel:+1>;tag=q", "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>",
                                "Call-ID: c", "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE"], "reject", "identity")
check("tel-empty", ["From: <tel:+>;tag=q", "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>",
                    "Call-ID: c", "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE"], "reject", "syntax")
check("tel-in-ruri", ["From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q", "To: <tel:+12025550121>",
                      "Call-ID: c", "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE"], "accept")

# host rules
check("host-single-label", ["From: <sip:ember@localhost>;tag=q", "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>",
                            "Call-ID: c", "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE"], "reject", "identity")
check("host-hyphen-mid", ["From: <sip:ember@my-host.test>;tag=q", "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>",
                          "Call-ID: c", "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE"], "reject", "identity")
check("host-underscore", ["From: <sip:ember@my_host.test>;tag=q", "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>",
                          "Call-ID: c", "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE"], "reject", "syntax")
check("host-numeric-only", ["From: <sip:ember@123>;tag=q", "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>",
                            "Call-ID: c", "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE"], "reject", "identity")
check("host-ipv6", ["From: <sip:ember@[::1]>;tag=q", "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>",
                    "Call-ID: c", "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE"], "reject", "syntax")

# body boundary cases
check("body-only-crlf", BASE, "accept", body="\r\n")
check("body-lf-only", BASE, "accept", body="a\nb")
check("body-cr-only", BASE, "accept", body="a\rb")
check("body-htab-only", BASE, "accept", body="\t")
r = run(mk(BASE, "\r\n"))
print("info body-crlf wire tail:", json.dumps(r["wire"][-16:]))

print("%d failures" % len(fails))
PYEOF
cd /workspace && python3 tmp/t7.py 2>&1 | grep -vE "^ok "
